name: GoalMeter - The Band Around Givebutter's Meter
description: The frame the site owns around a third-party fundraising meter: the paper-2 band, the serif heading, and the area beneath it, matching MomentumStats so progress reads as part of the campaign page rather than a pasted-in box. READ THE CAPTURE CAREFULLY. The area under the heading is empty because Givebutter's widget script does not run here — and would not run inside any capture — so no screenshot can show their progress bar. On a real page the band ships COLLAPSED and reveals itself only once that script defines the givebutter-widget element; this harness page overrides the collapse with a global style so the layout is reviewable at all. The frame proves our half of the boundary and deliberately cannot prove theirs. A capture showing a filled meter here would mean the collapse had stopped working.
